title: Design, synthesis, antiproliferative activity, and molecular dynamics simulation of pyrazoline-based derivatives as dual EGFR and HER-2 inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9265-9279
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01169H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hani Mohamed Hafez, Basmat Amal M. Said, Ahmed M. Sayed, Eid Alatwi, Bahaa G. M. Youssif, Stefan Bräse, Hany A. M. El-Sherief
A new series of two different scaffolds was designed and synthesized. The structures of the new compounds were validated by IR, NMR, and elemental analysis. The new compounds were evaluated as antiproliferative agents targeting EGFR and HER2.
